body.statement: SPEC-7-6: An environment is the blob of Sigma's own manifest `{"schema": "sigma-resume.environment@draft-1", "hashes": [sorted lowercase node hashes]}` in canonical JSON, so its blob address is `sigma_resume`'s `environment_id` for the same hash set.
